name: Nareko The Mineral Appraiser
storyline:
The Last Paradise, said to lie somewhere deep in the mountains… Gensokyo
Within the Mountain of Youkai, the sacred land of Yamamba
Deep within the Sacred Forest
At the foot of a towering pyramid, a young girl stood

“Well then, I guess I’ll get started today too.”

Michigami Nareko
It’s Nareko-chan
She’s everyone’s cute roadside shrine spirit who loves riddles
She wakes up in the morning to think up riddles, takes a nap to recite them, and makes a few tweaks before going to bed at night.
Ever since that incident settled down, tourists have started coming by occasionally.
Her riddles are a huge hit with them.

But Nareko-chan has a secret.
Just one secret she can’t tell anyone.

“I have to stop the Anomalies that keep pouring out of the pyramid endlessly!”

That’s right, the anomaly isn’t over yet (at least in Nareco’s mind).
Sealing away those who emerge from the pyramid—that is Nareko-chan’s mission.
Gather the anomaly enemies, sort them out, and dispose of them according to local regulations!
Nareko-chan can do it!

Go for it, Nareko-chan!
If the anomaly enemies overflow, Gensokyo will be destroyed! (That won’t happen.)
summary:
This mini-game involves sorting the constantly appearing "Wonder Stone" and the "rocks found on the path toTH11SA Stage 1" left and right.

Get high scores by performing consecutive combos or by connecting and sorting Wonder Stone together!

*This game was created for Touhou Game Jam 2026, held in February 2026.
